subject: Regression
object: predict sentence-level TER scores on unseen data
source_sentence: Based on source sentences, their translations and their corresponding sentence-level TER scores, we train regression models that aim to predict sentence-level TER scores on unseen data.
title: Keywords: Under-resourced Languages, Synthetic Corpora, Machine Translation, Quality Estimation

subject: Models
source_sentence: We decide to keep two QE models for the rest of our experiments, one using the baseline feature set and one using the extended set, both trained on the concatenated corpora.
title: Keywords: Under-resourced Languages, Synthetic Corpora, Machine Translation, Quality Estimation

subject: translation systems
source_sentence: These translation systems are finally evaluated with four of the most popular automatic metrics according to two test sets.
title: Keywords: Under-resourced Languages, Synthetic Corpora, Machine Translation, Quality Estimation
